summary: The SDK has a Quick Look panel data model (items, clamped index, step, toggle, close) and a thumbnail path cache, but the shell does not draw the floating panel and apps get no view, extension or data-based preview API. Files has its own in-app previews for text, image, audio, PDF, folder and info cards.

features.apple: QLPreviewPanel: shared(), dataSource, reloadData(), refreshCurrentPreviewItem(), currentController
features.bifrost: springboard/sdk/src/peek.rs (PreviewPanel: set_items, step, toggle, reload_data, make_key_and_order_front, close); springboard/proto/src/peek.rs (ToShell::Preview 0x1e0, PreviewClose 0x1e1); wired: springboard/src/shell/preview_panel.rs
features.note: The SDK sends the messages, but the shell has no consumer for ToShell::Preview, so nothing is drawn. No shared() singleton, no refreshCurrentPreviewItem(), no controller responder chain. Wired into the UI in wiring wave 4 (0.5.41); verify on Midget for parity.
URL and title are carried (URL cut to 256 bytes, title to 96, at most 16 items). No display state.

Wave 1 (parity/integration 0d0412c3): pure model with host unit tests; not wired into apps or the shell, not yet tested on the VM or Midget. No data source protocol or delegate callbacks. The app pushes a whole list with set_items; there is no lazy loading block and no transition source frame. Headless tests: sdk/tests/parity_sdk-tests-01a.rs (panel_pulls_a_data_source_and_stops_at_the_item_cap, panel_display_state_is_kept_per_item_and_reset_by_a_new_list).

features.apple: QLPreviewView: init(frame:style:), previewItem, refreshPreviewItem(), displayState, autostarts, close
features.note: Wave 6 (b06, main): pure model with host unit tests; not wired into apps or the shell, not yet tested on Midget. The preview is a Files-owned page, not an SDK view an app can place in its own view hierarchy. Headless tests: sdk/tests/parity_sdk-tests-01a.rs (embedded_view_loads_an_autostarting_item_until_the_app_reports_ready, embedded_view_without_autostart_waits_at_ready, embedded_view_closes_with_its_window_only_when_asked).

features.feature: Built-in previews for common file types
features.apple: Quick Look generates previews for common file types (text, images, audio, video, PDF, documents)
features.bifrost: springboard/src/files/preview.rs (preview_for, line 28: text, image, audio card, video, PDF, folder summary, info card); springboard/src/files/mod.rs (spawn_preview: PDF text via the Books engine)
features.note: Only the Files app uses these. The SDK offers no built-in renderer, so other apps get nothing unless they render thumbnails themselves.

features.apple: QLThumbnailGenerator: request, update handlers, multiple representations
features.note: The SDK keeps no cache: the shell's thumbnails service draws and caches each picture (the answer names the cached raw image) and the app reads the reply or event. No update handlers, and a single result per request. Headless tests: sdk/tests/parity_sdk-tests-01a.rs (a_thumbnail_answer_names_its_cached_picture, a_thumbnail_event_is_read_only_from_its_own_service).

features.apple: Arrow keys and panel navigation through the data source; Space toggles the panel
features.bifrost: springboard/sdk/src/peek.rs (step, toggle); springboard/src/files/mod.rs (step_preview, line 438: previous or next file in the folder)
features.note: Files steps through its folder without wrapping. The SDK panel's step and toggle have no shell-side key handling yet. Headless tests: sdk/tests/parity_sdk-tests-01a.rs (panel_steps_through_the_list_without_wrapping).

Wave 3 (theme-22, parity/integration cf8e852d): pure model with host unit tests; not wired into apps or the shell, not yet tested on the VM or Midget. The model routes a file by its type and a searchable item by its longest matching domain, but no app registration reaches the shell and no searchable item preview is drawn. Headless tests: ui/tests/parity_sdk-tests-01a.rs (a_narrow_searchable_domain_beats_a_broader_one, file_subjects_must_name_an_absolute_file, searchable_subjects_drop_a_blank_query).

Wave 6 (b06, main): pure model with host unit tests; not wired into apps or the shell, not yet tested on Midget. No out-of-process preview extension that returns data, PDF or HTML replies. Headless tests: ui/tests/parity_sdk-tests-01a.rs (preview_reply_rejects_bitmaps_outside_the_edge_limit, html_attachments_need_unique_usable_ids, nearer_registration_beats_an_ancestor_and_ties_go_to_the_first, preview_calls_the_provider_the_registry_picked). Wired into the UI in wiring wave 3 (0.5.39); verify on Midget for parity.

gaps: The shell does not draw the Quick Look panel: ToShell::Preview and PreviewClose are decoded and ignored (springboard/proto/src/lib.rs:677-679).
No app-facing preview extension point: no equivalent of QLPreviewingController or QLPreviewProvider.
No embeddable preview view (QLPreviewView) in the SDK.
The SDK has no built-in file renderers for QLThumbnailGenerator; each app renders its own thumbnails.
No thumbnail update handlers or multi-representation requests.
No panel data source or delegate protocol, no lazy loading block, and no display state for items.
The Files Quick Look menu item is not in springboard/apps/files/src/main.rs: the index returned a MENU_QUICK_LOOK constant there, but a grep of the current file finds none.
